I agree to 12 tons this month if all five of us explicitly accept, and I support Emma’s stock-based rule going forward. At 80 tons, taking 12 each would leave 20; if replenishment then fails, we’d start with 40 and reduce our limit to 4 each. That’s a useful safeguard against repeated unlucky months.

I also agree with Kate: any overcatch should lead to a discussion, not destructive retaliation. John, you’re the last person we need to hear from—do you accept both the 12-ton limit and the stock-based rule?
